user.title: ncplus TV
user.description: Turn on Settings > Remote API on the TV first. The screen there shows the address, port and token.

data_description.host: The TV's IP address or host name.
data_description.port: The Remote API port (9080 unless [api] PORT in netcast.conf says otherwise).
data_description.token: The token shown on the TV under ncplus Settings > Remote API (32 hex characters).

reauth_confirm.title: New ncplus token
reauth_confirm.description: The TV at {host} refused the saved token ("New token" in Settings > Remote API replaces it). Enter the token the TV shows now.

data_description.token: The token shown on the TV under ncplus Settings > Remote API (32 hex characters).

data_description.host: The TV's IP address or host name.
data_description.token: The token shown on the TV under ncplus Settings > Remote API (32 hex characters).

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the TV. Check the address, that the TV is on, and that Settings > Remote API is on.
error.invalid_token_format: A token is 32 hex characters (0-9, a-f).
error.not_netcast: Something answered, but it is not the ncplus API.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address answers for a different TV.

invalid_auth.message: The TV refused the token. Re-enter it under the integration's Reconfigure / Re-authenticate.

bad_hold.message: hold_secs must be 0.02 to 10 seconds (or 0 for a normal press).
